|                          |             | ## Military Service and Aviation Career                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |               |                                            |         |              |        |                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
|                          |             |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |               |                                            |         |              |        |                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
|                          |             | Before his NASA career, Musgrave served in the United States Marine Corps, where he worked as an aviation electrician and instrument technician. He became the youngest crew chief in USMC history[4]. His passion for flying led him to accumulate over 17,700 flight hours in 160 different types of civilian and military aircraft[2].                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |               |                                            |         |              |        |                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
|                          |             |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |               |                                            |         |              |        |                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
|                          |             | ## NASA Career                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |               |                                            |         |              |        |                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
|                          |             |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |               |                                            |         |              |        |                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
|                          |             | Musgrave was selected by NASA as a scientist-astronaut in August 1967. His NASA career spans an impressive 30 years, during which he:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |               |                                            |         |              |        |                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
|                          |             |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |               |                                            |         |              |        |                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
|                          |             | - Participated in the design and development of the Skylab Program                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |               |                                            |         |              |        |                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
|                          |             | - Worked on the design of Space Shuttle extravehicular activity equipment, including spacesuits and life support systems                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |               |                                            |         |              |        |                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
|                          |             | - Flew on all five Space Shuttles, becoming the only astronaut to do so                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |               |                                            |         |              |        |                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
|                          |             | - Completed six space flights, logging over 1,281 hours in space                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |               |                                            |         |              |        |                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
|                          |             | - Performed nearly 27 hours of spacewalks, including the first spacewalk off the Space Shuttle during Challenger's maiden voyage in 1983                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |               |                                            |         |              |        |                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
|                          |             | - Led the mission to repair the Hubble Space Telescope in 1993[1][2][3]                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |               |                                            |         |              |        |                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
|                          |             |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |               |                                            |         |              |        |                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
|                          |             | ## Notable Achievements                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |               |                                            |         |              |        |                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
|                          |             |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |               |                                            |         |              |        |                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
|                          |             | - Flew on six spaceflights: STS-6 (1983), Spacelab-2 (1985), STS-33 (1989), STS-44 (1991), STS-61 (1993), and STS-80 (1996)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |               |                                            |         |              |        |                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
|                          |             | - Became the second astronaut to fly on six space missions                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |               |                                            |         |              |        |                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
|                          |             | - Held the record for the oldest person to orbit Earth (at age 61) until John Glenn's return to space in 1998                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |               |                                            |         |              |        |                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
|                          |             | - Completed over 800 parachute jumps[2][4]                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |               |                                            |         |              |        |                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |

|                          |             | Musgrave's career is a testament to his insatiable curiosity, adaptability, and dedication to exploration and scientific advancement. Even after retiring from NASA in 1997, he has continued to contribute to various fields through consulting, public speaking, and sharing his vast knowledge and experiences[3][4].                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |               |                                            |         |              |        |                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
