|                          |             |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |               |                                            |         |              |        |                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
|                          |             | Born on March 17, 1930, in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, Irwin pursued a rigorous education[1][3]:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |               |                                            |         |              |        |                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
|                          |             |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |               |                                            |         |              |        |                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
|                          |             | - Graduated from the U.S. Naval Academy in 1951 with a Bachelor of Science in naval science                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |               |                                            |         |              |        |                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
|                          |             | - Earned a Master of Science in aeronautical engineering and instrumentation engineering from the University of Michigan in 1957                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |               |                                            |         |              |        |                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
|                          |             |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |               |                                            |         |              |        |                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
|                          |             | ## Military Career                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |               |                                            |         |              |        |                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
|                          |             |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |               |                                            |         |              |        |                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
|                          |             | After graduating from the Naval Academy, Irwin was commissioned in the U.S. Air Force[2]:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |               |                                            |         |              |        |                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
|                          |             |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |               |                                            |         |              |        |                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
|                          |             | - Received flight training at Hondo Air Force Base and Reese Air Force Base in Texas                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |               |                                            |         |              |        |                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
|                          |             | - Served with the F-12 Test Force at Edwards Air Force Base, California                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |               |                                            |         |              |        |                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
|                          |             | - Worked with the AIM 47 Project Office at Wright-Patterson Air Force Base, Ohio                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |               |                                            |         |              |        |                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
|                          |             | - Graduated from the Experimental Test Pilot School in 1961 and the Aerospace Research Pilot School in 1963                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |               |                                            |         |              |        |                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
|                          |             |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |               |                                            |         |              |        |                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
|                          |             | ## NASA Career                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |               |                                            |         |              |        |                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
|                          |             |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |               |                                            |         |              |        |                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
|                          |             | Irwin was selected by NASA as one of 19 new astronauts in April 1966[2][3]. His NASA career included:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |               |                                            |         |              |        |                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
|                          |             |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |               |                                            |         |              |        |                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
|                          |             | - Serving as backup Lunar Module pilot for Apollo 12                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |               |                                            |         |              |        |                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
|                          |             | - Being named to the prime crew for Apollo 15                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |               |                                            |         |              |        |                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
|                          |             |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |               |                                            |         |              |        |                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
|                          |             | ## Apollo 15 Mission                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |               |                                            |         |              |        |                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
|                          |             |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |               |                                            |         |              |        |                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
|                          |             | Irwin's most notable achievement was his role as Lunar Module pilot on the Apollo 15 mission (July 26–August 7, 1971)[1][2][3]:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |               |                                            |         |              |        |                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
|                          |             |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |               |                                            |         |              |        |                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
|                          |             | - Landed in the Hadley-Apennine region with Commander David R. Scott                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |               |                                            |         |              |        |                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
|                          |             | - Spent almost three days on the Moon's surface                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |               |                                            |         |              |        |                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
|                          |             | - Conducted three EVAs totaling 18 hours and 35 minutes                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |               |                                            |         |              |        |                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
|                          |             | - Drove the first Lunar Rover on the moon                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |               |                                            |         |              |        |                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
|                          |             | - Collected 171 pounds of lunar samples                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |               |                                            |         |              |        |                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
|                          |             | - Made significant geological discoveries, including the "Genesis Rock"                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |               |                                            |         |              |        |                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
|                          |             |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |               |                                            |         |              |        |                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
|                          |             | ## Post-NASA Career and Legacy                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |               |                                            |         |              |        |                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
|                          |             |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |               |                                            |         |              |        |                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
|                          |             | After retiring from NASA and the Air Force in 1972, Irwin focused on his faith[2][4]:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |               |                                            |         |              |        |                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
|                          |             |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |               |                                            |         |              |        |                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
|                          |             | - Founded the High Flight Foundation, a Christian evangelical organization                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |               |                                            |         |              |        |                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
|                          |             | - Shared his faith through speaking engagements, publications, and retreats                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |               |                                            |         |              |        |                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
|                          |             | - Made several expeditions to Mount Ararat in search of Noah's Ark                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |               |                                            |         |              |        |                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
|                          |             |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |               |                                            |         |              |        |                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
|                          |             | Irwin passed away on August 8, 1991, in Glenwood Springs, Colorado, due to a heart attack[1][2]. He was inducted into the U.S. Astronaut Hall of Fame on October 4, 1997[2].                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |               |                                            |         |              |        |                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
|                          |             |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |               |                                            |         |              |        |                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
|                          |             | James Irwin's legacy is marked by his significant contributions to space exploration and his dedication to sharing his faith after his NASA career. He is remembered as the eighth person to walk on the Moon and for his unique perspective on the importance of his spiritual experiences during his lunar mission[4].                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |               |                                            |         |              |        |                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
